Aisha (partnerships): FYI Caldera just marked the preview EAP as ready to close. Need a short wrap + a couple of follow-ups. Can bench team confirm final artifact set?
Ravi (benchmarks): working through final re-runs now. we found a perf regression when enabling `int8-fast` on their latest driver. investigating.
Nia (eng-ml): which workload? seq-len 512 or 2048?
Ravi (benchmarks): 512 mainly. fp16 still fine. int8-fast drops p95 by ~30% on short prompts.
Nia (eng-ml): interesting. can you attach the exact cmd and env? e.g. `./run_bench --model redwood-xl --quant int8-fast --seq 512`
Ravi (benchmarks): will push cmd+env to s3 and tag in here. also adding a short repro script `bench/repro_int8_fast.sh`
Aisha (partnerships): partner asked if we could try `int8-safe` profile before handback. can we run that tonight?
Nia (eng-ml): yes. queueing `int8-safe` w/ same seeds. ETA ~3 hrs
Max (solutions): marketplace team wants a one-liner about supported drivers and a note about explicit opt-in for telemetry. Priya — we need legal OK
Priya (legal): legal OK on drivers list as long as it's factual (list versions) and we include "customer metrics may vary" and telemetry opt-in language. no benchmarking claims like "best" or "faster than X".
Aisha (partnerships): noted. Ravi when you upload results ensure README has: drivers, kernel versions, compile flags, and telemetry blurb. also a partner-facing summary (1-2 lines) for joint announcement
Ravi (benchmarks): upload in progress: s3://redwood-eap/caldera/1947654321/{int8-safe.csv,int8-fast_regression_logs.tar.gz,README.md}
deploy-bot: upload complete: s3://redwood-eap/caldera/1947654321
Nia (eng-ml): added flamegraph sample (flame_int8_safe.svg) and small profile slice. README now lists `caldera-driver-2.4.3`, `rkn-3.8.1` and compile flags: `-O3 -fno-fp-contract`.
Priya (legal): quick redline: replace "collects telemetry" with "collects optional telemetry to help troubleshoot preview issues; customers may opt out." Also add retention period: 30 days for preview artifacts unless partner requests longer.
Aisha (partnerships): good call. Ravi update README accordingly
Ravi (benchmarks): updated. also documented the regression and the mitigation (fallback to fp16 for short prompts). added an entry to KNOWN_ISSUES.md
Max (solutions): draft marketplace blurb: "Caldera Systems (preview) — supported on Caldera D64; tested with driver caldera-driver-2.4.3. Typical throughput ~350 tokens/s (fp16) depending on prompt shape."
Priya (legal): tweak: change "tested" -> "validated in internal preview runs"? hmm that might read like a claim. use "tested in Redwood preview" and keep the rest. also add "Customer metrics may vary."
Aisha (partnerships): go with Priya's wording. Max update and paste final blurb here
Max (solutions): final: "Caldera Systems (preview) — tested in Redwood preview runs on Caldera D64 with driver caldera-driver-2.4.3. Typical throughput ~350 tokens/s (fp16); customer metrics may vary."
Aisha (partnerships): looks good. last items for handoff checklist:

```
Caldera EAP closeout checklist
- perf CSVs + repro scripts uploaded
- README with drivers/flags + telemetry opt-in + retention
- KNOWN_ISSUES.md present
- flamegraph/profile sample
- marketplace blurb signed off by legal
- NDA final countersigned
- partner demo scheduled
```

Ravi (benchmarks): done for CSVs, repro, flamegraph, KNOWN_ISSUES
Nia (eng-ml): readme updated with telemetry opt-in and retention note
Priya (legal): blurb approved and NDA shows countersignature in the portal
Aisha (partnerships): great. partner demo: proposed windows tomorrow 10:00 PT or 15:00 PT. which works for Eng?
Nia (eng-ml): 10:00 PT works for me
Ravi (benchmarks): 10:00 PT good
Max (solutions): I'll own partner-facing slide deck. ping me any screenshots you want included
Aisha (partnerships): deploy-bot please set s3 ACL to `partners-read` and create a short pre-signed URL for partner artifact bundle
deploy-bot: ACL updated and presigned URL created: https://s3.redwood.example/presigned/caldera/1947654321
Aisha (partnerships): sending presigned link to partner now. will close thread after demo completes. thanks y'all :raised_hands:
Ravi (benchmarks): quick note: I'll schedule a post-demo follow-up to decide whether to promote `int8-safe` to default for D64
Nia (eng-ml): noted. adding that to our backlog."
